# R3c evals — Payment flow (no screen): failure reasons, late settlement, pay sequence

> Base for every diff check in this file is commit `a7313cd`, not origin/main. Allowed changed paths are the five in R3c.1 only.

Run all commands from the worktree root (`.claude/worktrees/flat-redesign`). Source of truth: `docs/build/redesign-spec.md`, "Rules" and "R3c Payment flow (no screen)". A check is PASS only if the stated expectation holds; any other result is FAIL. Written from the spec, not from the builder's code. No database, no paid API, no network: tests use fake deps and a fake `window.Razorpay`. Do not print `.env*`.

Vitest named checks: PASS needs exit 0 and output matching `1 passed` (a zero-match skip is FAIL). Test titles are matched as substrings with `-t`.

R3c-01. Run under bash or zsh.

R3c-02. Frozen files untouched — cmd: `test -z "$(git diff a7313cd --stat -- src/components/covers/AddCoverView.tsx src/adapters/documents-contract.ts src/adapters/payments.ts src/app/api/app/payments package.json package-lock.json src/styles/tokens.css src/app/page.tsx src/components/landing)"; test $? -eq 0 && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- src/app/api/app/payments src/components/landing package.json package-lock.json)"` — expect: exit 0 — PASS if none of AddCoverView, `ERROR_TEXT` file, payments adapter, payments BFF routes, package.json, package-lock.json, tokens.css, landing page and landing components differ from `a7313cd` (no new dependency). If `documents-contract.ts` lives elsewhere, FAIL and report the path.

Constructor exact — cmd: `grep -nE 'constructor\(public code: string, public retryable = false, public reason: string \| null = null\)' src/adapters/types.ts` — expect: exit 0, one match — PASS if the signature matches the pin and `super(code)` and `this.name = "AdapterError"` remain in that class (`grep -A3` it).

R3c-04. Two-argument callers still typecheck — cmd: `npm run typecheck` — expect: exit 0 — PASS if exit 0 (existing `new AdapterError(code)` and `new AdapterError(code, retryable)` calls compile).

## C. razorpay.ts surface and privacy

R3c-05. Exports and closed set — cmd: `f=src/lib/razorpay.ts; grep -qE 'export const PAY_FAIL_REASONS = \["declined", "insufficient_funds", "timed_out", "authentication", "bank_unavailable", "other"\] as const' $f && grep -qE 'export type PayFailReason = \(typeof PAY_FAIL_REASONS\)\[number\]' $f && grep -qE 'export function reasonOf\(raw: unknown\): PayFailReason' $f && grep -qE 'retry:\s*\{\s*enabled:\s*true\s*\}' $f && grep -q 'description: "Add another policy"' $f && grep -qE 'export (async )?function payWithRazorpay' $f` — expect: exit 0 — PASS if all six appear exactly as pinned.

R3c-06. No provider text read — cmd: `! grep -nE 'error\.(description|code|source|step|metadata)|\.(description|source|step|metadata)\b|\[.(description|code|source|step|metadata).\]' src/lib/razorpay.ts && ! grep -n 'description' src/lib/razorpay.ts | grep -v 'description: "Add another policy"'` — expect: exit 0, no output — PASS if the only `description` in the file is the Razorpay option key `description: "Add another policy"` and no `error.code`, `.source`, `.step`, `.metadata` is read.

R3c-07. Reason only read from `error.reason` and only when a string — cmd: `grep -nE 'reason' src/lib/razorpay.ts | grep -E 'typeof .* === "string"|typeof .*"string"'` — expect: exit 0, at least one match — PASS if `reasonOf` guards the value with a string type check before lower-casing. Behavior is proven by R3c-12/13.

R3c-08. Rejection uses our codes only — cmd: `grep -qE 'new AdapterError\("PAYMENT_FAILED", true, ' src/lib/razorpay.ts && grep -qE 'new AdapterError\("PAYMENT_CANCELLED"\)' src/lib/razorpay.ts` — expect: exit 0 — PASS if both rejections exist as pinned (retryable true with the stored reason; cancelled with one argument).

## E. Behavior (named tests, exact titles)

R3c-12. razorpay tests, all 8 titles exist and pass — cmd: `f=tests/lib/razorpay.test.ts; for t in 'reasonOf maps each known family and falls back to other' 'reasonOf ignores description, code and non-string reasons' 'resolves with the three ids when the handler fires' 'a failure does not settle; closing the window after it rejects PAYMENT_FAILED with the reason' 'a failure followed by a success in the same window resolves with the proof' 'closing the window with no failure rejects PAYMENT_CANCELLED' 'the rejected error carries no provider text' 'passes retry enabled and the order fields to Razorpay'; do grep -qF "$t" $f || { echo "MISSING $t"; exit 1; }; done; npx vitest run $f 2>&1 | tee /dev/stderr | grep -qE '8 passed' && ! npx vitest run $f 2>&1 | grep -qE 'failed|skipped|todo'` — expect: exit 0 — PASS if all 8 titles appear verbatim, 8 tests pass, none skipped or failed.

R3c-13. pay-flow tests, all 13 titles exist and pass — cmd: `f=tests/components/pay-flow.test.ts; for t in 'happy path goes opening, confirming, paid' 'order refused with PAYMENTS_DISABLED stops and cannot pay again' 'order refused with POLICY_SLOT_AVAILABLE re-reads slots and reports paid' 'a closed window stops with PAYMENT_CANCELLED and can pay again' 'a failed payment keeps its reason and can pay again' 'verify retries a retryable failure and then reports paid' 'verify failing three times falls back to slots and reports paid when a slot is free' 'verify and slots both failing stops as PAYMENT_UNCONFIRMED, keeps the proof and cannot pay again' 'a non-retryable verify refusal skips further verify tries and still re-reads slots' 'confirmPay with a kept proof can reach paid without opening the window again' 'no state after a proof exists has canPayAgain true' 'payCopy returns the pinned text for every row' 'runPay and confirmPay never throw'; do grep -qF "$t" $f || { echo "MISSING $t"; exit 1; }; done; npx vitest run $f 2>&1 | tee /dev/stderr | grep -qE '13 passed' && ! npx vitest run $f 2>&1 | grep -qE 'failed|skipped|todo'` — expect: exit 0 — PASS if all 13 titles appear verbatim, 13 tests pass, none skipped or failed.

R3c-14. Failure paths, named — cmd: `npx vitest run tests/lib/razorpay.test.ts tests/components/pay-flow.test.ts -t "a failure followed by a success in the same window resolves with the proof|verify and slots both failing stops as PAYMENT_UNCONFIRMED, keeps the proof and cannot pay again|no state after a proof exists has canPayAgain true|runPay and confirmPay never throw|order refused with PAYMENTS_DISABLED stops and cannot pay again"` — expect: exit 0 and output matches `5 passed` — PASS if exactly those five pass (failed-then-paid resolves; verify plus slots exhausted gives PAYMENT_UNCONFIRMED with the proof kept and `canPayAgain` false; no proof state allows pay again; no throw; disabled stops without pay again).
